answer: Beacon jitter correlation: each identity must emit a periodic heartbeat with timing jitter drawn from a per-identity seed, and the network checks that successive jitter values stay correlated like a ferrous signal under magnetisation. New identities get zero inbound traffic until they survive a canyon of random probes whose timing matches their seed. A sybil farm must run each clone long enough to build that history, costing it real wall-clock time and server hours per identity.
